clips.title: The story
paras: At Lakeshire Town Hall, Magistrate Solomon directs Redridge's affairs from the heart of Lakeshire. Blackrock orcs and gnolls bring relentless threats to the lakeside settlement.

Lakeshire Town Hall, an aging stone building, has been refurbished many times over the years. It stands prominently in Lakeshire and houses Magistrate Solomon, a kind and dedicated civil leader who maintains order in the eastern reaches of the Kingdom of Stormwind. Stormwind's military is stretched thin, and royal aid is scarce. The hall has changed from a quiet administrative office into an active command center, where desperate appeals for volunteer defenders and mercenaries are processed daily.

Gnoll incursions and the encroaching Blackrock orcs have driven Magistrate Solomon to desperation. With aid scarce, he readily accepts help from independent adventurers who come through the town hall doors.
